title: Database Import should not overwrite existing data
symptom: When importing an old database into xDrip+ on a new phone, the existing data is overwritten, causing loss of new values. Also, after import, the calibration for a running Dexcom G6 sensor is lost, forcing recalibration with blood.
cause: The current procedure is a complete restore of a backup database, which overwrites all existing data. The menu item is incorrectly named 'Import database' when it actually performs a restore.
fix: The menu item was renamed from 'Import' to 'Restore' to clarify behavior. There is no capability to import without overwriting; users should transfer the database before setting up the new phone as a collector. For Android 11 issues, refer to issue #1705.
evidence_quote: We have renamed the menu item from "Import" to "Restore" to avoid this confusion. There is currently no capability to import a database leaving the existing database intact.
